claims.value: Command A+ is an open source Sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 25B active and 218B total parameters, optimized for agentic, multilingual, and reasoning-heavy tasks, supporting text and image inputs with 48 languages.
claims.evidence: Command A+ is an open source model with 25 billion active parameters and 218B total parameters model optimized for agentic, multilingual, and reasoning-heavy tasks with a focus on enterprise performance, while also providing support for vision inputs
Command A+ supports a context length of 128K & 64K output length.

Command A+ has been specifically trained with conversational tool use capabilities. ... Tool use with Command A+ is supported through chat templates ... Input: Text and images. Output: Model generates text.
